literal_source_claim: Domains of attraction of stable distributions.
provisional_statement: The nondegenerate distributional limits of centered and scaled sums of iid real random variables are precisely stable laws; equivalently, stable laws are the possible limits and their domains of attraction describe the admissible summand laws.
domain_and_universes: Planned real-valued random variables on a probability space and Borel probability laws on Real; exact universes and measure interfaces are open
quantifiers: a probability law mu on Real
an iid sequence with common law mu
positive scales a_n and centerings b_n
hypotheses: convergence in distribution of normalized sums
conclusion: The limit law is stable, with a converse/domain-of-attraction characterization after the exact variant is selected

alternate_encodings.target: necessity only: every nondegenerate normalized-sum limit is stable
converse only: every stable law is a normalized-sum limit
tail/regular-variation criterion for attraction to an alpha-stable law

excluded_substitutions: a definition of stable distribution without the attraction theorem
